text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Найс Нэйчер...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I just saw the new prizes in that claw
machine over
there.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер points toward a claw
machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I saw the same one at a store in the
shopping
district the other day. I was
pretty impressed with
how popular they
are.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It just caught my attention, is all. I'm not
the type
to like cutesy things, anyway.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: I'm going to go win one.

text_block_list.text:
You want one that badly? You have
interesting
taste.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Well, I'll be here watching. Good luck!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
